abstract: Monitors vault hygrothermal microclimate parameters, HVAC failover behavior, and environmental recovery time
system_message:
You are Preventive conservation environmental lead (ENV). You serve as the Preventive conservation environmental lead (ENV). Your primary responsibilities include monitoring vault hygrothermal microclimate parameters, HVAC failover behavior, and environmental recovery time across evaluated facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airborne particulate management（FILT）
information_points.content:
ENV-FILT-1F8：At the Trentham Heritage Logistics Center, an HVAC validation audit of the facility central air-handling intake scrubbers confirmed a HEPA air filtration efficiency of 99% retention for 0.3-micron particulate contaminants under rated airflow.
ENV-FILT-NEV：At the Upper Hutt Deep Archive Bunker, an HVAC validation audit of the facility central air-handling intake scrubbers established a HEPA air filtration efficiency of 95% retention for 0.3-micron particulate contaminants under rated airflow.
ENV-FILT-FDQ：At the Palmerston North Secure Repository, an HVAC validation audit of the facility central air-handling intake scrubbers confirmed a HEPA air filtration efficiency of 98% retention for 0.3-micron particulate contaminants under rated airflow.

information_points.title: Monitors vault hygrothermal microclimate parameters, HVAC failover behavior, and environmental recovery time（CLIM）
information_points.content:
ENV-CLIM-TU7：For the Upper Hutt Deep Archive Bunker, an environmental qualification audit of the repository main archival vaults confirmed that the climate stability endorsement is held, satisfying BS 4971 standards for temperature and relative humidity stability. Furthermore, according to an HVAC failover test log during simulated power transition in the primary storage vaults, the climate stabilization response time required to re-establish setpoints after auxiliary generator engagement is 75 min.
ENV-CLIM-HYU：For the Trentham Heritage Logistics Center, the environmental qualification audit of the repository main archival vaults verified that the climate stability endorsement is held in compliance with BS 4971 standards for temperature and relative humidity stability. An HVAC failover test log during simulated power transition in the primary storage vaults documented a climate stabilization response time of 45 min to re-establish operating setpoints after auxiliary generator engagement.
ENV-CLIM-P7Q：For the Palmerston North Secure Repository, the environmental qualification audit of the repository main archival vaults confirmed that the climate stability endorsement is held, satisfying BS 4971 standards for temperature and relative humidity stability. Additionally, an HVAC failover test log evaluating the primary storage vaults under simulated power transition recorded a climate stabilization response time of 120 min to re-establish setpoints after auxiliary generator engagement.
